t: You're at the St Michael Cornhill War Memorial, a First World War memorial beside the entrance to the church, facing Cornhill in the City of London. The memorial is Grade II* listed, since December 2016, and the church behind it is Grade I listed. It was made by Richard Reginald Goulden, an English sculptor who lived from 1876 to 1932 and worked in the early twentieth century. Take a moment to read the memorial itself.
